answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The voyage cap is upheld at intake and signal shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a lagoon tag. That is 14 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
